source: due2-native: right operands with no reading (decisions/0013)
notes: Not valid ODRL 2.2: IM §2.5.1 gives a Constraint one rightOperand value, and allows a set of values only for a set-based operator; odrl22-shape.ttl fails both constraints. Contrast due2-repeated-right-operand, where repeated values on isAnyOf are admitted.

expected_rejection.why: ex:readOne gives eq, which is not set-based, two right-operand values; ex:readMixed gives isAnyOf a list together with a further value. Neither has a reading (due2-profiles.md §4), so W1 rejects the policy in stage 2.
